# Flutter

`flare_im_ui` covers Flutter mobile and desktop using Theme, Semantics, Focus, and native window input.

## Installation

Use the [installation guide](/en/guide/install) and COMPATIBILITY.md for versions, platform minimums, and package names.

## Basic Usage

~~~dart
import 'package:flare_im_ui/flare_im_ui.dart';
FlareButton(label: "New message", onPressed: startConversation)
~~~

## State

The host owns state and passes it explicitly. Components do not duplicate SDK data or start network requests.

## Configuration

Complex components use defaults + capabilities + host configuration; focused primitives keep a small controlled API.

## Callbacks / Events

Every side effect returns through callbacks, events, or intents; failure and offline states retain recovery.

## Slots / Builders

Replace only targeted Header, Footer, Leading, Trailing, Empty, Loading, Error, Message Renderer, Composer Action, and Navigation Item regions.

## Theme

Generate from tokens/tokens.json and connect to the native theme environment; six brands and Light/Dark share semantic roles.

## Responsive

PC, tablet, and mobile/H5 share semantics while using hover/keyboard/context menus or touch/long press/bottom sheets natively.

## Accessibility

Validate keyboard or platform focus, screen readers, Large Text, High Contrast, Reduced Motion, and 48 logical-pixel touch targets.

## Platform Notes

The website does not simulate native visuals. Vue preview validates Web behavior; Flutter, Compose, and SwiftUI visual regression remains in native test projects.
